data.narrative:
ideaForge is a Defense & Security company at the public stage, having raised $50M+ to date. The valuation universe for this analysis spans 26 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private-stage companies including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage clustering. The Defense & Security sector contains only 1 public-stage comparable within the same valuation tier, falling materially short of the 3+ datapoint threshold required for reliable peer median triangulation. Expansion to adjacent-stage or valuation-tier peers yielded no additional matches. An all-sector median would introduce excessive sectoral heterogeneity and obscure defense-specific dynamics around regulatory risk, procurement cycles, and technology differentiation.

Given data constraints, this analysis cannot support a defensible triangulated valuation range at this time. Robust pricing would require either: (1) expansion of the public comparable set through international defense-tech listings or public SPAC mergers in adjacent geographies; (2) detailed revenue multiples or profitability metrics from the private peer cohort; or (3) transaction-derived valuations from recent funding rounds or M&A activity in the space. The 2 public tickers merit individual fundamental review, but their comparability to ideaForge's stage, scale, and technology focus remains unvalidated without granular metrics.
